minutes.headline: Committee voted to hire Rich Matthew as finance director and to request free cash for the special ed reserve fund.
minutes.summary: The committee interviewed Rich Matthew in public and voted to hire him as director of finance and operations, pending contract negotiations. It approved FY27 line-item transfers, declared outdated literacy materials surplus, and heard MCAS and DIBELS results. It voted to request free cash for the special education reserve fund at the November town meeting, discussed track and turf costs and capital planning, declined any school use of the Brooks House or shared driveway access, and approved the paraprofessional contract.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted unanimously, by roll call, to hire Mr. Matthew as director of finance and operations, pending contract negotiations.
The committee voted unanimously to request free cash for the special education reserve fund if certified at the November town meeting, via the warrant article already voted.
Members tied the reserve request to out-of-district placement costs and overages this year, and agreed the request waits on free cash certification.
Members discussed track drainage, wall repair and turf costs and capital planning with no resolution; the superintendent is to bring a timeline to the next meeting.
The committee approved FY27 line-item transfers, accepted new paraprofessional contract terms, and voted that the schools have no need for the Brooks House or driveway access for a buyer.

why_it_matters: The free cash request is a ask for town money at the November town meeting, a vote residents will be asked to take, and it bears on how out-of-district special education costs are covered.
The new finance director will prepare the school budget that residents vote on, and the transfers show some FY27 accounts running negative this year.
Track and turf work and the share of capital spending going to schools are unsettled and likely to return as costs for the town budget.
watch_next: November town meeting: free cash certification and the special education reserve fund article.
Next School Committee meeting: the track and field timeline, a facilities report, and the finance director's contract.
